Reviewed `441da9325ce4` against base `28dffd793dbb`.

The missing gather-template AVG divisor and stale template count are fixed. Normal and swapped routes use the routed-row extent, matching the existing non-gather contract. The registry comparison retains inventory coverage. No actionable finding.

Validation: Reviewed all six changed files and a clean merge with develop. Checked the four template declarations, routed capacity versus source-token rows, empty routing, block-scale test buffers and registry enumeration. Synchronization and reduction accumulation order are unchanged; this does not add a determinism guarantee (checklist A01/C10). Native SM100, CuTeDSL 4.8.0: all nine focused regressions passed. The eight AVG variants cover plain/block-scale, normal/swapped and gather/non-gather execution with several routing lengths, including full and empty routing, and both scalar and per-feature outputs. The SM100 report contains 11,622 cases with no failures; all nine focused regressions passed there too. Style, Security and metadata checks passed. The two prior base failures are resolved. Inspected the four CodeQL unused-variable reports: generated AVG snippets consume moe_used_rows. The declarations must remain. Precheck has no candidates and PR metadata is complete.

Limitations: Focused native execution used SM100 and the existing one-CTA regression configuration. No standalone performance or general bitwise-repeatability result is claimed; the existing reduction algorithm is unchanged.

Approved: no P0 or high-risk P1 found. Remaining findings stay with the owner; merge timing stays with the owner.
